articles.title: The curious case of pending nod to a six-year CEO that may delay Noida airport
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the Noida International Airport at Jewar, Uttar Pradesh, on March 28, 2026. Located 100 km from Delhi's Indira Gandhi International Airport, this new facility is a significant infrastructure project. It aims to boost air connectivity and economic development in the region, demonstrating India's commitment to expanding its modern transportation network and supporting regional growth.

articles.title: What the War Against Iran Means for the U.S.-South Korean Alliance
articles.summary: South Korea's security concerns now extend globally, transcending the Korean peninsula. The Strait of Hormuz standoff highlights this new reality, compelling Seoul to recognize its broader strategic interests. This necessitates a re-evaluation of its defence posture and international engagement to protect vital global trade routes and economic lifelines crucial for its prosperity.

articles.title: FCRA Amendments: Freedom vs Regulation
articles.summary: India's proposed 2026 amendments to the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Act (FCRA) have sparked significant national controversy. This legislation, which governs foreign funding to Indian organizations, frequently draws scrutiny regarding its implications for NGOs and civil society. For SSB aspirants, understanding such domestic policy debates is crucial for current affairs knowledge and appreciating India's regulatory landscape.

articles.title: The silent submarine hunter that could reshape future naval warfare
articles.summary: Saildrone, recognized for its decade-long work building long-endurance autonomous sail/hybrid sea vessels for ocean data collection and mapping, is now adapting this advanced technology. The company is developing next-generation capabilities, likely a new class of "super" autonomous craft, to further advance marine exploration and data gathering. This innovation marks a significant step in marine robotics.

articles.title: Sharjah Architecture Triennial Presents "A Journey into Architecture Archives" Focused on Baghdad, Damascus, and Tunis
articles.summary: The Sharjah Architecture Triennial (SAT) presents 'A Journey into Architecture Archives: Baghdad, Damascus, Tunis.' This exhibition curates and showcases significant architectural history and archives from these key Middle Eastern cities. It features notable works like Raffaele Contigiani's Hotel du Lac in Tunis (1973), offering an insightful exploration into the region's rich architectural heritage and promoting cultural appreciation.

articles.title: Government funds counter-drone tech that can track coin-sized objects
articles.summary: Australia's federal government has signed contracts with two domestic companies to acquire advanced counter-drone technologies. This strategic move, informed by critical lessons learned from ongoing conflicts abroad, aims to bolster national defence capabilities. It underscores a proactive approach to enhancing Australia's security infrastructure against the growing threat of sophisticated drone warfare.

articles.title: Sub that sank Iranian warship reflects Navy’s drive to adapt, CNO says
articles.summary: A U.S. submarine recently sank an Iranian warship, a mission executed after the submarine was trained and dispatched on short notice. The U.S. Chief of Naval Operations cited this rapid deployment as a prime example of the Navy's exceptional operational readiness and quick-response capabilities. This incident demonstrates their efficiency in executing critical missions effectively.

articles.title: Real-time metric for factory output
articles.summary: Over ten years since its launch, "Make in India" remains central to India's development strategy. The initiative aims to significantly increase manufacturing's share in GDP from its current 15-16%. This sustained national focus on boosting domestic production is crucial for fostering economic growth, creating employment opportunities, and positioning India as a global manufacturing powerhouse, aligning with broader national strategic objectives.
